target.title: [AI-assisted] feat(android): add chat command controls
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: Android chat lacked a visible new-chat control and slash-command suggestions in the composer.
- Solution: Add a header New Chat action backed by Gateway `sessions.create`, and add composer slash-command controls backed by Gateway command metadata.
- What changed: Android now loads Gateway text commands, filters slash suggestions by command name or text alias prefix, starts new sessions with unique `New chat` labels, preserves Gateway new-chat hook semantics with `emitCommandHooks=true`, and includes focused Android tests plus native i18n updates.
- What did NOT change (scope boundary): Android does not request or persist `operator.admin`; admin-gated reset behavior is not part of this PR body claim.

## Motivation

Android users should be able to start a fresh chat and discover supported slash commands from the chat screen without relying on hidden flows or a hard-coded Android command catalog.

## Change Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope

- [ ] Gateway / orchestration
- [ ] Skills / tool execution
- [ ] Auth / tokens
- [ ] Memory / storage
- [ ] Integrations
- [x] API / contracts
- [x] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue/PR

- No linked issue; team-approved Android PR.
- [ ] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior or issue addressed: Android chat exposes a New Chat control, `/new` starts a fresh session, and slash suggestions filter by command name or alias prefix.
- Real environment tested (affected runtime/layer, not just "unit test"): Connected Android emulator running the PR `playDebug` APK against an isolated local Gateway.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:

```bash
./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest
./gradlew :app:assemblePlayDebug
```

- Evidence after fix:

```text
Focused Android coverage locks command metadata parsing, slash prefix filtering, unique New Chat labels, and the parent-linked sessions.create payload with emitCommandHooks=true.
Android emulator recordings show the new chat button, /new, /reset slash-command interaction, and slash command filtering in the connected app.
```

- Public artifact URLs, if screenshots/videos/files are referenced:

Header `+` creates a unique new chat session:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/15d788e5-60a9-4c4f-bef9-043800ad61d4

`/new` starts a new session:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3bb3428-a7fb-44d3-81c9-8cf0c49e2c65

`/reset` slash-command interaction:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19b75a73-4189-4a4a-a990-b6dccbf4c4fb

Slash command filtering:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b00ddccb-e6d7-4b1f-9df4-03a55382b2c3

- Observed result after fix: The header `+` creates a new uniquely named session, `/new` starts a new chat, `/reset` can be selected as a Gateway-provided slash command, and slash suggestions narrow by command name or alias prefix only.
- What was not tested: Full Android release build matrix and non-emulator physical-device pairing were not re-run in this phase.
- Before evidence:

```text
Prior Android chat UI did not expose these composer-level command controls or a visible new-chat action.
```

- Visual proof:
  - Before screenshot/video: Not recorded for this PR body update.
  - After screenshot/video: Public Android emulator videos linked above.
  - If not applicable, why: The visible changed behavior is represented by the linked after recordings.
- Remaining proof gap: None for the reported Android New Chat and slash-command UI behavior. Hook-contract behavior is covered by focused Android test assertions rather than video.

## Root Cause

- Root cause: Android chat had session and command APIs available through the Gateway, but the UI did not expose a dedicated new-chat action or composer slash-command picker.
- Missing detection / guardrail: There was no focused Android coverage for Gateway command metadata filtering, unique new-chat label creation, or the parent-linked `sessions.create` hook flag.
- Contributing context (if known): Android previously depended on less discoverable chat flows and did not keep the command picker aligned with Gateway-provided command metadata.

## Regression Test Plan

- Coverage level that should have caught this:
  - [x] Unit test
  - [ ] Seam / integration test
  - [ ] End-to-end test
  - [ ] Existing coverage already sufficient
- Target test or file: `ChatControllerCommandControlsTest` and `ChatCommandControlsTest`.
- Scenario the test should lock in: New Chat calls `sessions.create` with the selected parent session, `emitCommandHooks=true`, and a unique label; slash suggestions match command names and text aliases by prefix only.
- Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail: These tests lock the Android controller and picker behavior without needing a full Gateway or emulator run for every CI pass.
- Existing test that already covers this (if any): New focused Android tests added in this PR.
- If no new test is added, why not: Not applicable.

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

Android chat now shows a visible New Chat action and slash-command suggestions in the composer. Users can create fresh sessions from the header or via `/new`, and command suggestions come from Gateway metadata instead of an Android-local fallback catalog.

## Diagram

```text
Android Chat UI
  -> ChatController.refreshCommands()
  -> Gateway commands.list
  -> Slash picker filters by command name/text alias prefix

Android Chat UI + /new
  -> ChatController.startNewChat()
  -> Gateway sessions.create(parentSessionKey, emitCommandHooks=true, label)
  -> New uniquely labeled session becomes selected
```

## Security Impact

- New permissions/capabilities? No. Android does not request or persist `operator.admin` in the current PR head.
- Secrets/tokens handling changed? No.
- New/changed network calls? Yes. Android chat now calls existing Gateway `commands.list` and `sessions.create` methods from the chat surface.
- Command/tool execution surface changed? No new tool execution surface; this exposes existing text command metadata and new-session creation in Android chat.
- Data access scope changed? No broader data scope intended.
- If any `Yes`, explain risk + mitigation: The new Gateway calls use existing Gateway method contracts; reset/admin behavior is intentionally not claimed here.

## Repro + Verification

### Environment

- OS: Android emulator, plus Lenovo WSL `OpenClawUbuntu` for Android build/test commands.
- Runtime/container: Android `playDebug` APK connected to an isolated local Gateway.
- Model/provider: Not model-dependent.
- Integration/channel (if any): OpenClaw Android app connected to local Gateway.
- Relevant config (redacted): Local Gateway pairing details omitted.

### Steps

1. Install the PR `playDebug` Android APK on the emulator.
2. Pair the app to the isolated local Gateway.
3. Open Chat.
4. Tap the header `+` and observe a unique new chat session.
5. Type `/new` and submit it.
6. Type `/reset` and submit/select the Gateway-provided slash command.
7. Type `/`, `/n`, `/mo`, `/de`, `/runtime`, and `/session` to verify slash suggestion filtering.

### Expected

- New Chat creates and selects a uniquely labeled fresh session.
- `/new` starts a fresh session.
- Gateway-provided slash commands, including `/reset`, can be selected from the composer flow.
- Slash suggestions match names and aliases by prefix only.
- Description/category text does not produce matches.

### Actual

- Matches expected behavior in focused Android tests and linked emulator recordings.

## Evidence

- [ ] Failing test/log before + passing after
- [ ] Trace/log snippets
- [x] Screenshot/recording
- [ ] Perf numbers (if relevant)

```text
Focused Android tests:
- ChatControllerCommandControlsTest
- ChatCommandControlsTest

Build/proof commands reported for this PR:
- ./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest
- ./gradlew :app:assemblePlayDebug

Latest source guard added after review:
- ChatControllerCommandControlsTest asserts the parent-linked sessions.create payload includes emitCommandHooks=true.

Public Android emulator recordings are linked in Real behavior proof.
```

## Human Verification

- Verified scenarios: Header New Chat creates a unique session; `/new` starts a new session; `/reset` slash-command interaction is recorded; slash command filtering narrows by name or alias prefix.
- Edge cases checked: `/` lists commands, `/n` matches `/new`, `/mo` matches `/model`, `/de` matches alias `/delegate` for `/agent`, `/runtime` and `/session` do not match description/category text.
- What you did **not** verify: Full Android release matrix, physical device pairing, and admin-gated reset behavior.

## Review Conversations

- [ ] I replied to or resolved every bot review conversation I addressed in this PR.
- [x] I left unresolved only the conversations that still need reviewer or maintainer judgment.

## Compatibility / Migration

- Backward compatible? Yes.
- Config/env changes? No.
- Migration needed? No.
- If yes, exact upgrade steps: Not applicable.

## Risks and Mitigations

- Risk: Gateway command metadata could include commands Android should not present.
  - Mitigation: Android displays Gateway-provided text command metadata and filters only by command name/text alias prefix; admin-gated reset behavior is not claimed by this PR body.
- Risk: Session labels could collide when multiple New Chat sessions exist.
  - Mitigation: The controller chooses the next available `New chat`, `New chat 2`, `New chat 3`, etc. label and has focused test coverage.
- Risk: Parent-linked New Chat could skip Gateway lifecycle hooks.
  - Mitigation: Android now sends `emitCommandHooks=true` in the parent-linked `sessions.create` payload and has focused test coverage for that contract.
